entries.subject: DAMIT 515: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-515.txt. Model 515, version 2013-02-11, pole (331°, 59°), period 6.05581 h match the retained metadata. The archive supplies no diameter for this model; a separate scale constraint is required. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.

entries.subject: Physical scale
entries.finding: The retained calibration uses 31.962 ±0.789 km. effective body diameter

entries.subject: SBDB-selected two-band size 27.927 ± 0.507 km
entries.finding: [SBDB-selected two-band size 27.927 ± 0.507 km](https://ssd-api.jpl.nasa.gov/sbdb.api?sstr=787&phys-par=1) — excluded — Prefer later Masiero 2014 fully-cryogenic W3/W4 fit 31.962 ± 0.789 km with fitted beaming parameter and lower systematic floor; retain the different-epoch result as evidence of model/geometry dependence.
entries.revisitWhen: New source evidence resolves the recorded calibration or spatial-registration limitation; compare it with the selected product before replacement.

entries.subject: Other DAMIT shape solutions
entries.finding: The live DAMIT export lists these other models for this target: 516: pole (126°, 27°), 6.0558 h, version 2013-02-11. These are archive alternatives, not necessarily newly released models or preferred replacements. Comparing their source methods and any pole-specific calibration remains necessary before changing the selected mesh.
entries.revisitWhen: Independent shape, spin or scale evidence distinguishes these alternatives, or a changed release offers a demonstrably better supported model.
